name: @immunity-wars/android
description: The Android shell: the app's own web build, wrapped by Capacitor.

scripts.build: echo "no build output: pnpm android:apk builds the app"

comment:what-this-is: Ruled 2 October 2026 (docs/LOOK_PLAN.md section 26): the Android app is the same web app inside a Capacitor shell, with the whole game bundled so it plays with no connection. `android/` is the native project Capacitor generated, committed, and changed in the few places AndroidManifest.xml says. `www/` is the app's build made for the shell (`pnpm android:web`), built and never committed. Building the app itself needs Android Studio's Java and the Android SDK, named by JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME: see README.md.
